proposal.summary: The armv8_dec_aes_gcm_full() API of Arm AArch64cryptolib before commit 86065c6 fails to verify the authentication tag of AES-GCM protected data due to an improperly initialized variable, enabling a man-in-the-middle attack.

C.quote: fails to the verify the authentication tag of AES-GCM protected data

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and patch armv8_dec_aes_gcm_full() to ensure proper initialization of all variables and verify authentication tags; coordinate disclosure and release a fixed library build.
